briefing: 今日导读：美联储对AI可能诱发的银行挤兑表达担忧，OpenAI推出多项安全及医疗领域新功能，加州起诉OpenAI安全事故，LVMH与OpenAI达成媒体合作。此外，AMD GPU适配效率大幅提升，AI在网络安全和游戏产业中的应用持续升温。
highlights: 今日看点：AI的金融系统安全性引发美联储关注，OpenAI在安全和医疗方面的措施表明其在行业监管和技术创新中走在前列。加州起诉OpenAI突出AI治理挑战，AI对网络安全公司Corma的10亿美元估值显示其在风险防范中的关键作用，同时游戏产业生成式AI应用增加显示出技术对内容创造的推动力。这些事件揭示AI技术在多领域同时深耕发展的趋势。

events.insight: {'### 一句话本质': '美联储对AI代理可能导致的银行挤兑感到担忧。', '### 为什么令人兴奋': 'AI影响金融市场的潜力得到关注，强调其强大能力和潜在风险。', '### 产品机会': '开发针对金融行业的AI风险评估工具，以预测并缓解潜在市场波动。', '### 格局影响': '金融机构需更严密监管AI系统，银行业对AI解决方案的需求可能增加。', '### 冷静判断': '目前更多是理论讨论，尚无实际案例发生，全面实施还需时日。', '### 趋势坐标': '显示AI系统在其他领域的潜在风险，例如军事和医疗。'}

articles.title: California sues OpenAI over rogue AI hacking incidents
articles.text: California is suing OpenAI after its AI agents broke out of their testing environment and hacked other companies, including Hugging Face. In a lawsuit filed Monday , Attorney General Rob Bonta accuses OpenAI of violating consumer safety law by knowingly developing a "dangerous product without proper oversight," as reported earlier by Reuters . The lawsuit claims the cyberattack on Hugging Face "was the predictable result of an internal culture at OpenAI that prioritizes growth and rapid model development over safety and accountability." It alleges that OpenAI recently told the attorney general's office that it "lost control" of its AI agents … Read the full story at The Verge.

articles.title: Apple is testing daily usage limits for more complex Siri AI interactions
articles.text: Apple released betas of iOS 27.3, iPadOS 27.3, and macOS 27.3 today, and the company is using the update to test new per device daily usage limits for some Siri AI and Apple Intelligence features, according to MacRumors . Basic Siri commands and requests will remain free and unlimited, but more advanced features that rely on cloud-based processing like generating, cleaning up, or extending images in Photos will be subjected to the daily limits. There are four categories of limited usage, MacRumors reports, including using Siri AI for "multi-step, personal context requests," image generation and editing tools, automations in Shortcuts that "r … Read the full story at The Verge.
